name: Oscar Global Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, Oscar Global Ltd 
is in the business of exporting Leather 
Garments of all kinds[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
OGL was engaged in the production 
and export of the leather garments and accessories, with a primary market focus on Europe. It used to manufacture, supply
 and export a variety of products like:
a) Leather Garments
b) Leather Jackets
c) Leather Bag
d) Leather Coats
e) Leather Pants

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.56% over last 3 years.
